content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration varies by post and programme: Telemedicine (Medical Officer): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. NHM (PHC), Fifteenth Finance Commission, and PM-ABHIM / NHM (Medical Officer): Rs. 80,000/- Basic + Rs. 20,000/- Performance Based PBI per month. Maternal Health Programme (Lady Medical Officer): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. Child Health Programme (Medical Officer): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. District Hospital Treatment Strengthening Programme (MO): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. NPCDCS (General Physician): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. NTEP (Medical Officer): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. Blood Cell (Medical Officer): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. Terms and Conditions: Appointments are purely on a contract basis for the current financial year and are renewable based on performance evaluation by the District Health Society. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease. The maximum age limit is 65 years as of the date of notification publication. No TA/DA is admissible for interviews.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMO Banda Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Prepare your latest biodata (CV) along with self-attested photocopies of all required documents including high school mark sheet/certificate, intermediate mark sheet/certificate, MBBS degree, State Medical Faculty registration certificate, experience certificate if any, Aadhaar card, PAN card, two latest passport-size photographs, and caste certificate / EWS certificate. Ensure the application is filled correctly as per the notification guidelines. Send the complete application via registered post to the office of the Chief Medical Officer, Banda. The last date for receipt of applications at the CMO office is 28 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. Is this CMO Banda Medical Officer post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: Appointments are made strictly on a contract basis for the current financial year under National Health Mission (NHM) guidelines, with no claim for regularisation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be above 65 years of age as of the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be enclosed with the offline application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested photocopies of their high school and intermediate certificates, MBBS degree, State Medical Faculty registration, experience certificate, Aadhaar card, PAN card, two photographs, and caste or EWS certificate along with their biodata.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit filled applications by registered post to the office of the Chief Medical Officer, Banda is 28 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the consolidated salary for the Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 per month depending on the specific programme, with additional Performance Based PBI (up to Rs. 20,000) for select NHM positions.
